key_insight: BAR helps LLMs reason over medical knowledge graphs in a budget-aware way while producing verifiable, citable evidence for risk prediction.
clinical_relevance: This could support post-discharge complication risk prediction from EHRs by adding external medical knowledge that is traceable for review.
method: Builds disease-specific evidence graphs from a medical KG with support scores and provenance.
Uses an LLM plan-navigate-verify loop to retrieve evidence under a patient-specific budget.
Trains a reasoning policy with prediction gain, acquisition cost, and citation-integrity rewards.
evidence_signal: Evaluated across 8 diseases and 3 horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improved AUPRC by 3.4 points, raised citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and used 62-65% of the budget cap.
watch_item: The approach depends on KG quality and citation/provenance coverage, so performance may drop if the external knowledge is incomplete or noisy.
paper_title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
